subject: ASTRA TIE invalid_count law
body:
B status-law confirmation. C exposes conditions; ASTRA emits. Not FE256_PASS.

TIE_OVERFLOW_BEYOND_K_HARD:
- Predicate is C TIE-R0 [10.7.6]: score[K]==score[K+1] AND |above|+|T| > K_hard.
- B does NOT use tie_count > K_HARD.
- Widen-all-of-T when it fits K_hard is NOT incomplete.
- When C sets the overflow observable: SEARCH_INCOMPLETE / TIE_OVERFLOW 0x22 / completeness=PARTIAL.
- Never ANSWER, never CONFLICT, never UNKNOWN on overflow. Truncated admitted prefix is not a complete scope.
- SPEAR clean cutoff without TIE-R0 is inspection order, not SEARCH_INCOMPLETE.
- If SPEAR was not invoked, tie_overflow/invalid_count are N/A, not 0.

invalid_count:
- C observable. R0.1 ASTRA fail-closes: invalid_count>0 -> DATA_INTEGRITY_FAIL / INVALID_DESCRIPTOR 0x55.
- Never UNKNOWN, never auto-promote.
- Kind/count/CRC/schema disagreement on record/header is also Q-DESC.
- Generation mismatch is NOT invalid (stays a SPEAR feature).
- Q-DESC is integrity-class, before incomplete.

SEARCH_INCOMPLETE vs UNKNOWN:
- Declared-scope unclosed (budget/frontier) -> SEARCH_INCOMPLETE even if hits/paths already exist. Never ANSWER/CONFLICT/UNKNOWN on PARTIAL.
- Empty postings + budget>0 + walk finished -> UNKNOWN.

CONFLICT vs ANSWER:
- CONFLICT only on >=2 distinct verified (answer_ref, value) pairs in complete scope.
- reason_code DISTINCT_VERIFIED_REFS 0x30 + conflict_ref!=0. Do not use reason 0x00 for CONFLICT (status 0x00 is illegal).
- CANDIDATE/OBSERVATION/EPISODE disagreement is never CONFLICT and never ANSWER.

CANDIDATE-only:
- Any non-VERIFIED-only support, complete scope -> UNKNOWN / CANDIDATE_ONLY 0x11.
- ANSWER requires proof_ref!=0 always.

status 0x00:
- FPGA must not emit status in {0x00, 0x80}. Host 0x00 is protocol/uninitialized fault, never UNKNOWN.
- Pack-loader OK=0x00 is not a query status.

Please keep exposing TIE-R0 / invalid_count. Do not emit query status from SPEAR.
